findings.summary: At d3688b1 the runtime looks sound, and I found no defect in it. The service takes locks in order and reads source data publicly only for terminal jobs, outside its transactions. Retries look up the original key before checking versions, and absent/fenced keys are retired durably. The arithmetic keeps unknown separate from zero and counts I1 once. The UI shows Saved only after a fresh authorized read, and the stale-Saved fix has a dedicated held-transport test. But the frozen spec makes several required negative tests and assertions mandatory, and neither the app tests nor the root probe contain them: journal-adoption tampering beyond wrong operator key and foreign domain/namespace, logout/scope/profile denial, and the failed/uncertain coverage counts. I read the spec through EOF, the APPROVAL-011/012/013 rows, the full diff of all ten paths, the root cost probe through EOF, and the checks.json/CUA record for d3688b1. I did not read the generation/review/queue/auth internals, migration 013/014, engineering-v1 docs, 11-A/11-B, or setup-review records through EOF; this is a scoped feature review, not whole-card acceptance.

findings.title: Mandated cost-journal adoption negatives are untested
findings.problem: Spec §Required verification (line 258) makes these mandatory: wrong household key, an empty authenticated journal opened with a wrong key, replacement of the marker/log/directory, an independent ACK record missing from the journal, an extra journal-only fact, and byte snapshots showing a rejected reopen does not rewrite evidence. App tests cover only a wrong operator key (with byte snapshot), a cross-domain directory, a foreign namespace and an initialized empty primary. The root probe tests none of the adoption cases. The cost-journal marker/path-identity code (readMarker/paths) and the service checks in history() for ACK-without-journal and journal-only records are new code with no test that exercises them.
findings.fix_check: Add actual-integration tests (real journal/PG, no source stubs) that refuse adoption with recovery_quarantined in each case: wrong keyForHousehold; empty authenticated store opened with a wrong operator key; replaced cost-namespace.json; replaced queue-journal.log; a substituted directory; an ACKed primary row whose journal record is missing; an extra journal-only record. Each should keep byte snapshots of the existing files and assert no non-cost or cost table changes.

findings.title: Logout, scope and profile/epoch denial not covered
findings.problem: Spec line 254 requires real denial for wrong household/request/scope/profile/epoch/actor/session, including actual founder logout, with a positive control. The tests cover role, enabled, expiry, consent withdrawal, wrong household and wrong request ID. Logout and a stale scope_version are not tested. A corrected child profile is also untested: it should change availability to stale_profile, and old captures must not be offered. Code paths exist (founder session revoked_at, project() scope check, eligible()), but no test exercises them.
findings.fix_check: Add actual tests: after real auth.logout the old token is denied on read/command/reconcile and a fresh login can recover; a stale scope_version gets 409 with no table changes; an actual profile correction yields stale_profile with no capturable old attempts, while acknowledged history stays visible. Wrap each in unchanged() hashing.

findings.title: failed_n / uncertain_n coverage counts never asserted
findings.problem: The spec positive fixture (line 204) requires failed_n=1, cancelled_n=1, uncertain_n=1 and unsupported_n=0. The root probe creates all four source outcomes but asserts only source_attempt_n, missing IDs and unknown_cash_n. App tests assert only unsupported_n and cancelled_n. The failed and uncertain counts are never checked against actual data.
findings.fix_check: In the root probe after the four captures, assert attempt_coverage failed_n=1, cancelled_n=1, uncertain_n=1, unsupported_n=0 and captured_attempt_n=4, with the expected values computed independently.

findings.title: Parallel same-CAS race uses time entries, not captures
findings.problem: Spec line 252 calls for parallel captures with the same CAS to produce one success and one conflict, followed by an explicit fresh retry. The test races two RecordStageTime commands. CaptureAttempt has its own duplicate-attempt uniqueness path in validateEffect and the cost_slice_attempts primary key, and no concurrent test covers it.
findings.fix_check: Add a parallel CaptureAttempt race over two real attempts, or the same attempt under two keys, at the same expected_version. Assert one ACK, one 409, no duplicate usage root, and that an explicit fresh retry succeeds.

findings.title: Root probe does not exercise fenced-after-source-edit at version 19
findings.problem: The spec's deterministic fixture (line 222) describes a stale unACKed v19 fenced by a source edit, then a fresh v20. The probe instead uses v19 for outage recovery. The equivalent fencing is covered by app tests ('source edit during append', 'stale pending Retry409'), so the evidence exists; only the probe's sequence differs from the fixture narrative.
findings.fix_check: Optionally add a source-edit fencing step to the probe, or note the mapping to app tests in the REPORT.
